name: B.Grimm Power Public Company Limited
summary: B.Grimm Power Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, financing, construction, and operation of green-field power plants in Thailand and internationally. The company operates through Electricity Generating and Other Businesses segments. The Electricity Generation segment generates and distributes electricity for the government sectors and industrial users and procure and wholesale liquefied natural gas. The Other Businesses segment provides investment holding, maintenance, and operating services for power plants.
